lookback_summary: Well, what a weekend it was in the Premier League! The model had a mixed bag, but it did manage to call some key results correctly. It nailed the draw between Fulham and Man United, which I must say, was a surprise to many. However, I had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace match where the model was wrong, predicting a home win when it ended in a stalemate. The standout prediction had to be Newcastle, though, as the model confidently backed them as a banker, and they delivered against Hull City. Overall, there were some hits and misses, but it looks like the model still has a few tricks up its sleeve!
